root_idea.summary: The supplied lexical evidence centers the root on lowering oneself onto the knees and adopting a kneeling posture, with related extensions to sitting together and gathered bodies or heaps.
root_idea.development: From the basic bodily posture of kneeling, derived forms express reciprocal or causative kneeling, while several nouns denote collected bodies, stones, or earth. These are lexical extensions and do not make every derived form a Quranic synonym.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized masculine singular active-participle citation form.
Displayed under the standard verbal-noun citation form جُثُوّ, with the Quranic variant جِثِيًّا noted in usage.

senses.definition: Kneeling; sitting upon the knees in an upright posture.
senses.usage_conditions: In جَاثِيَةً in 45:28, the active participle is feminine singular with أُمَّة and describes each nation as kneeling, not sitting at ease.

senses.definition: Forming a gathered company or congregated body.
senses.usage_conditions: In 45:28, this is an alternative lexical interpretation of جَاثِيَةً, understood collectively rather than solely as a description of bodily kneeling.

senses.definition: Kneeling; the posture or act of sitting upon the knees.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form جِثِيًّا may be understood either as a plural or epithet meaning “kneeling ones” or as the verbal noun used adjectivally. It occurs in descriptions of people kneeling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stand on the extremities of the toes.
To collect camels and sheep or goats.
To sit knee-to-knee with another, each sitting upon the knees, especially in disputation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal construction involving two people sitting in the kneeling posture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to sit upon the knees.
To cause someone to stand on the extremities of the toes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An alternative causative usage of Form IV.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sit together upon the knees in mutual contention or disputation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reciprocal or collective Form VI usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To vie with others in lifting a stone as a trial of strength.
A company or congregated body of men; a group or company.
A particular idol to which sacrifices were offered.
A collection or heap of stones or earth; a mound or grave, including certain ritual heaps or stones in the sacred territory.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning covers collected natural material and related named stone collections.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A live coal or piece of fire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical equivalence with جَذْوَةٌ is reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The middle of a thing.
The body together with its limbs or members.
A great or large man.
A person or the human body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as an equivalent of a word for a person or bodily form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An incubus or nightmare.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited usage is also written جَثَا without the final hamzah.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Requital or compensation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported lexical equivalence with جَزَاءٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Quantity, measure, size, bulk, extent, amount, sum, or number.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer, for example, to the size or number of a people or company.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sitting generally, without the specific restriction to kneeling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader classical use of the active participle distinct from the Quranic kneeling construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The constellation Hercules.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A traditional astronomical expression, including الجَاثِي عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place for sitting upon the knees.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Kneeling is represented in the Quranic verbal-noun sense; standing on the toes is represented separately.
Collection of camels and small livestock.
The two causative outcomes are both represented.
Company or congregated body, also used to explain the collective Quranic reading.
Collected stones or earth, mounds, graves, and related ritual stone collections.
Live coal or piece of fire.
Pointer-only reference to the preceding entry.
Covers kneeling, the collective Quranic reading, standing on the toes, and general sitting.
Place of kneeling or sitting upon the knees.

cautions: جَاثِيَةً in 45:28 has two explicitly reported readings here: kneeling and forming a gathered company; both are retained as Quranic senses.
جِثِيًّا may be analyzed as a plural or epithet derived from جَاثٍ, or as a verbal noun used adjectivally.
